title: Weight measures of two represented currents agree on an open set where the currents agree (supplied step 5)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let S, T ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) be currents represented by integer multiplicity triples RS and RT in ℝ^P (RS.Represents S, RT.Represents T), and let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Suppose S(ω) = T(ω) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ O. Then the weight measures agree on O: RS.measure⌞O = RT.measure⌞O (Measure.restrict).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (RS RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (O : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O → RS.Represents S → RT.Represents T → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ O → S ω = T ω) → RS.measure.restrict O = RT.measure.restrict O
